purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Chiclayo’s municipal cadastre function and an urban cadastral survey are confirmed by official municipal sources. The municipal open-services page and national thematic GIS do not expose a verified safe parcel feature schema. No parcel search was submitted.
registryAssessment: The Municipality of Chiclayo’s official organization page assigns its Instituto Metropolitano de Planificación Territorial y Gestión Catastral responsibility for maintaining the urban cadastre within its district scope and delivering GIS services. Municipal resolutions and current project notices also name the Chiclayo urban cadastral survey.
